subcommittees.name: Public Lands, Forests, and Mining Subcommittee

dimensions.assessment: Affects federal land permittees, livestock operators, and communities near public lands and national forests.
Establishes formal strategies for targeted grazing, temporary permits, and cooperative agreements.
Authorizes cooperative agreements and potential reimbursements under existing authorities, but specifies no direct new spending amounts.
Directs broad agency planning, technological integration, and stakeholder coordination for public lands management.
dimensions.evidence: develop a strategy to utilize livestock grazing as a wildfire risk reduction tool

dimensions.assessment: Requires a strategy within 18 months, with permanent implications for grazing management practices.

missing_information: Specific acreage or federal land units that will be designated for targeted grazing.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires the Departments of Agriculture and the Interior to develop a comprehensive strategy utilizing livestock grazing as a wildfire risk reduction tool on federal lands.
